title: dynamic-monorepo.config.json
description: Configuration for the dynamic-monorepo GitHub Action: projects, their dependencies, and which changes affect what.

projects.description: Explicit projects. Keys are project names (used in matrices). Explicit entries win over inferred or discovered ones.

detect.description: Auto-detect projects from marker files (package.json, go.mod, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, pom.xml, build.gradle, *.csproj, Dockerfile, Chart.yaml). On by default when there is no config file; off unless set to true when there is one. Explicit projects override detected ones.

infer.description: Infer projects and dependencies from ecosystem manifests: node = package.json workspaces / pnpm-workspace.yaml, go = go.work + go.mod, cargo = Cargo.toml [workspace].

import.description: Import a project graph produced by another tool.

nx.description: Path to the output of `nx graph --file=<path>.json`.

discover.description: One project per sub-directory, named after the directory. Only the "<dir>/*" form is supported.

targets.description: Repository-wide per-target settings. Changes matching a target's exclude globs don't trigger that target anywhere (e.g. test-only edits don't redeploy).

global.description: Globs whose changes select every project.

ignore.description: Globs whose changes are ignored everywhere.

glob.description: Repository-root-relative glob. Supports *, ** and ?; a trailing / means /**.

path.description: Directory owned by the project; the deepest match wins. "." is the repository root.

targets.description: Which of build/test/deploy/docker the project appears in. Default ["build", "test"]. Use the object form for per-target excludes.

include.description: Extra files (outside path) that belong to the project.

exclude.description: Files under path that never count as changes.
